rationale: Two y axes with unrelated scales (revenue $M left, churn % right): the apparent crossing point is an artefact of the scale choice. Both axes carry labels with units, so coverage.axis_labels is satisfied and the figure scores 10. Proposed: fire when two vertical axis lines (or two rotated axis labels) sit on opposite sides of the plot.
